# ARCTURA

> ARCTURA is a public education organization for people who reason across
> complex technical systems. Its learning model combines
> concepts, cases, inspectable artifacts, and review.

Canonical domain: https://arctura.org/

Public contacts: learn@arctura.org for learning and accessibility;
signal@arctura.org for corrections, public-record coordination, and responsible
security disclosure.

## Primary routes

- [ARCTURA home](https://arctura.org/): Mission and three-domain learning model.
- [Learning](https://arctura.org/learning/): Public curriculum catalog and shared learning method.
- [Start here](https://arctura.org/learning/start/): Choose a path and complete a first 30-minute practice cycle.
- [Learning method](https://arctura.org/learning/method/): Concept, case, artifact, review, and the shared rubric.
- [Engineering Judgment](https://arctura.org/learning/engineering-judgment/): Decisions under constraint, uncertainty, evidence limits, and review.
- [Decision Record practice](https://arctura.org/learning/engineering-judgment/decision-record/): Guided artifact for alternatives, evidence, tradeoffs, and review triggers.
- [Semantic Ontology](https://arctura.org/learning/semantic-ontology/): Shared concepts, relationships, states, provenance, and competency questions.
- [Domain Model practice](https://arctura.org/learning/semantic-ontology/domain-model/): Guided artifact for vocabulary, relationships, provenance, and test questions.
- [Systems Stewardship](https://arctura.org/learning/systems-stewardship/): Useful work, accountable roles, review, records, and system improvement.
- [Review Cycle practice](https://arctura.org/learning/systems-stewardship/review-cycle/): Guided artifact for roles, gates, exceptions, records, and feedback.
- [About ARCTURA](https://arctura.org/foundation/): Mission, status, commitments, and ecosystem boundaries.
- [Editorial standard](https://arctura.org/editorial/): Sources, claim classes, review, generated assistance, and corrections.
- [Accessibility](https://arctura.org/accessibility/): WCAG target, current implementation, known limits, and feedback.
- [Legal and educational boundaries](https://arctura.org/legal/): Institutional, educational, privacy, and security statements.

## ARCTURA-sponsored project

- [Arctura Observatory](https://arctura.org/observatory/): Applied-learning and public-record project. Intended future home: https://arctura.space/.
- [Observatory tools](https://arctura.org/tools/): Browser-local Signal Brief and Claim Record builders.
- [Evidence records](https://arctura.org/case-studies/): Bounded records that distinguish facts, interpretations, and unknowns.
- [Observatory directory](https://arctura.org/field/): Transitional project route map.

## Separate ecosystem surface

- [Arctura Network](https://arctura.network/): Separate initiative for useful work, review, agreement, and operating records. ARCTURA does not confer Network authority through this site.

## Current boundaries

- Three guided practice modules are public. They are independent learning resources, not active cohorts or accredited courses.
- ARCTURA does not currently claim degree authority, recognized certification, incorporated nonprofit status, active grantmaking, or guaranteed learner outcomes.
- The Observatory does not verify user-supplied information and will migrate route by route only after equivalent arctura.space pages are ready.
- Legacy Academy operator tiers, agent payment/control-plane concepts, and mythology archives are not part of the current public architecture.
